lines.text: GTA 6 just got a ninety-nine on Metacritic.
That ties the highest score any game has ever had there.
The only other game up there is Zelda: Ocarina of Time, from nineteen ninety-eight.
It even beats Rockstar's own records, because GTA 4 sits at ninety-eight and GTA 5 at ninety-seven.
And this is not one lucky review, more than a hundred critics went into that number.
The score can still move a little as more reviews come in, so keep an eye on it tonight.
If you pre-loaded, the wait is almost over, because it reportedly unlocks at midnight on PS5 and Xbox Series.
Part two is your call: A, what reviewers loved most, or B, what they did not like?
